ministries.title: Tuesday Bible Study

events.title: Annual Community Outreach Fall Festival
events.text: Greater St. Paul’s annual Community Outreach Fall Festival. Saturday, October 24, 2026, 12–3 PM. Family activities include a gaming truck, hot dogs, chips, popcorn and group games. The church flyer invites guests to wear a creative costume. Admission cost is not specified on the flyer; confirm with the church.
events.costNote: Admission cost is not specified on the church flyer.

moments.title: Preaching the Word
moments.text: The message from the pulpit on Give Thanks Sunday.
moments.accessibility: A minister in black preaches into a microphone behind the pulpit, framed by large arrangements of yellow, purple and white flowers and a Give Thanks banner.
moments.albumText: The Sunday after our Fall Festival, the sanctuary was dressed in flowers beneath the banner of Psalm 106:1: “Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; His love endures forever.”
